caption: The drawing displays two objects rendered in brown tones against a plain beige background. On the left, there is a large, rectangular, wooden panel divided vertically into five sections with framing details, giving the appearance of a paneled structure. The panels are bordered by narrow wooden strips, and small dot-like marks indicate fasteners or nails. Directly to the right of the panel, there is a profile view of a wooden chair featuring a high, straight, rectangular backrest, horizontal seat support, and two horizontal braces between the legs. The chair’s armrest is straight at the back then curves downward toward the front. The composition is simple, with the objects separated and the entire drawing bordered by a single dark outline. A small inscription is located in the lower left corner.
title: Settee
